## WF-07 - Notification Dispatcher

Milestone 8. Standalone, reusable sub-workflow following the same pattern as WF-02 through WF-06. Called by WF-06 via an Execute Workflow node. Takes one routing decision and PREPARES + ROUTES a notification payload (destination + formatted message). It does NOT send anything -- actual Telegram delivery is a separate workflow (telegram-notifier), planned for the next milestone.

## Team -> Telegram Chat Mapping

Chat IDs are placeholders (TELEGRAM_CHAT_*). Replace with real Telegram chat/group IDs before wiring the telegram-notifier workflow. Unmapped teams fall back to the NOC default chat rather than being undeliverable.

## Error Handling

- Missing incidentId / siteId / assignedTeam / priority / notificationPolicy -> Error Output - Invalid Input, listing exactly what is missing.
- assignedTeam not in the mapping table -> not an error, falls back to the NOC default chat.
- businessImpact / affectedCustomers / slaDeadline missing -> defaults gracefully, payload still completes.
